pose: A slender, high-visibility gunmetal grey pole buoy topped with a long, flexible fiberglass whip antenna flying a brightly striped racing pennant flag. A predatory Enchodus (fang-tooth fish) is dynamically breaching out of the water directly behind it.

environmental_details.ground: Murky olive-green water filled with drifting sea-grass particles, swirling over a dark, sandy tan seafloor base.
environmental_details.atmosphere: Soft afternoon sun filtered through a thin coastal marine layer, creating highly volumetric shadows in the water splash.
